global_style_prompt: Pure black and white only. Simple hand-drawn architectural sketch with solid black ink, a slightly human irregular line, minimal detail, generous negative space, centered composition, and no frame. Keep the concept recognizable at thumbnail size but intentionally incomplete. A restrained three-quarter view is allowed for building values; perspective values should read as clean architectural diagrams.
global_negative_prompt: No color, gray, grayscale shading, gradients, shadows, realistic lighting, photorealism, architectural visualization, finished concept art, detailed floor plans, construction documents, realistic materials, excessive texture, hatching, watercolor, people, furniture, cars, unnecessary plants, text, labels, arrows, dimensions, logos, borders, frames, registration marks, collage layouts, multiple alternative views, or a fully designed final building.

prompts.prompt: Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Garden shed. Show a small simple shed as a compact block in a restrained three-quarter view, with one clear pitched roof, a plain door, and at most one tiny functional detail. Use a few confident black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Make it a simple hand-drawn sketch, recognizable in two seconds and open enough for the user to draw their own version.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Bus stop shelter. Show a minimal shelter as a thin open frame with two or three slender supports and one simple canopy, with no bus or street scene. Use confident black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep it human and slightly imperfect, like a quick hand-drawn architectural sketch rather than a finished design.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Treehouse. Show one compact elevated room nestled against a single simple tree trunk, with a small platform and one ladder hint. Use only the marks needed to show that the room is supported by the tree. Draw it as a centered, slightly imperfect black architectural ink sketch on white with generous empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Row house (terrace). Show two or three adjoining narrow house bays as a repeated street-facing mass, with one repeated roof rhythm and a few simple doors. Use sparse black architectural ink lines, centered on white with generous empty space. Keep the repetition recognizable but do not draw a detailed facade or finished streetscape.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Beach hut. Show a tiny raised hut with a simple box body, a lightweight roof, and two short support legs. Suggest the beach-hut character through the elevated compact form only, without drawing a beach or ocean. Use a centered, hand-drawn black ink sketch on white with very few lines and generous negative space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Library. Show a calm, substantial rectangular public building mass with two or three stacked horizontal volumes and one clearly marked entrance. Use simple black architectural ink contours on white, with no books, people, or detailed windows. The result should be a quiet, centered hand-drawn massing sketch with generous empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Art museum. Show an abstract public building with one bold gallery volume and a simple recessed entry, using a slightly sculptural but very sparse massing outline. Use solid black hand-drawn architectural lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Avoid artwork, visitors, signage, and facade detail; communicate only the civic gallery mass.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Hillside cabin. Show a small cabin stepping down a single diagonal slope, with a simple pitched roof and two offset floor levels. Use only a few black architectural ink lines to show the cabin adapting to the hill. Keep the centered sketch sparse, human, white-backed, and intentionally unfinished.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Greenhouse. Show a light rectangular greenhouse frame with a simple pitched or curved roof and a few visible structural ribs. Use sparse black ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Do not fill it with plants or render the glass; communicate the delicate frame and transparent volume only.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Lakeside villa. Show a low, elongated villa with a broad roof plane and one open-facing side, using a restrained three-quarter massing view. Use only a few black architectural ink lines on white; do not draw a lake, furniture, or luxury details. Keep the simple villa centered and open for the user's own interpretation.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Observatory. Show a heavy simple base topped by a small dome, with the dome as the single defining feature. Use confident but sparse black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Avoid telescopes, stars, landscape, and technical detail; show only the base-and-dome silhouette.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Train station. Show a long simple station hall with one clear large-span canopy and a short platform edge, but no train or people. Use a few centered black architectural ink lines on white with generous negative space. Make the long-span structure readable without turning it into a detailed transportation scene.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Cathedral. Show a tall vertical nave silhouette with one pointed roof or pointed arch gesture, emphasizing height and upward direction. Use sparse black hand-drawn architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space. Do not add religious symbols, stained glass, people, or ornamental facade detail.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Skyscraper. Show one tall slender tower mass with a simple readable base, shaft, and top, plus a restrained vertical structural rhythm. Use only a few black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Avoid a city skyline, windows repeated across the facade, and realism; communicate vertical scale through the silhouette.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Opera house. Show one dramatic sculptural roof or shell volume over a calm solid base, suggesting a public performance building without drawing performers or signage. Use sparse black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous negative space. Keep the gesture simple and incomplete, not a finished landmark rendering.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the BUILDING constraint Grain silo complex. Show a small cluster of three or four cylindrical silos with varied heights and one simple connecting pipe or conveyor hint. Use minimal black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Let the clustered circular forms carry the idea; avoid industrial landscape, machinery detail, and realism.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Flat open field. Show one long, perfectly straight ground line with almost no surrounding marks and a tiny neutral site marker only if needed to establish scale. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, door, or building type. Use sparse black hand-drawn architectural ink on white, centered with abundant empty space; the flat horizon should be the only idea.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Suburban cul-de-sac. Show a curved dead-end street with only two or three short driveway or curb lines and an empty lot marker at its end. Do not draw a building, house, facade, roof, door, cars, people, or a detailed neighborhood. Use minimal black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Wooded clearing. Show three or four tall, widely spaced tree trunks leaving a clear open gap as the site. Do not draw a building; use only a tiny neutral ground marker if the clearing needs an anchor. Use sparse black ink lines on white with generous negative space. Keep the trees as simple vertical marks, not a forest illustration.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Quiet residential street. Show a straight street edge with two low, abstract neighboring mass silhouettes behind an empty site gap. Do not draw a building, facade detail, roof, door, cars, people, signs, or a detailed neighborhood. Use a few black architectural ink lines on white, centered and sparse; show only the calm street relationship.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Corner lot. Show two straight, perpendicular street or ground edges meeting around an empty corner site. Use only the two intersecting edges and a tiny neutral lot marker if needed; do not draw a building, facade, roof, door, or streetscape detail. Render it as a centered black architectural ink sketch on white with generous empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Dense urban alley. Show two tall, close parallel wall edges forming a narrow alley and leaving only a thin strip of sky above. Do not draw a building inside the alley, windows, graffiti, people, or detailed city texture. Use sparse black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space beyond the alley marks.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Rooftop garden. Show a flat roof slab with a simple parapet and two or three simplified planter or plant marks. Do not draw a pavilion, building, facade, roof form, skyline, or garden landscape; the roof plane is the site. Use black hand-drawn architectural lines on white, centered and spacious.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Riverbank. Show one clear, gently irregular water edge with a small empty bank or neutral site marker beside it. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, door, reflections, boats, vegetation, or landscape detail. Use minimal black ink lines on white, centered with generous negative space; preserve the site-to-water relationship.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Desert plain. Show a stark long flat horizon with one or two sparse ground marks suggesting an empty arid expanse and a tiny neutral site marker only if needed. Do not draw a building, dunes, cacti, dramatic sun, or rendered atmosphere. Use confident black architectural ink on white and a large amount of empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Reclaimed marsh. Show a low water line, a few slender neutral site piers or a simple platform above it, and two or three reed marks below. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, or detailed wetland scene. Use sparse black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space; keep the marsh legible through elevation and water.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Town square. Show an open public void framed by two or three short abstract mass edges, with no facade detail. Do not draw a building, doors, roofs, crowds, signage, or a complete townscape. Use minimal black architectural ink on white, centered and spacious; the empty square is the subject.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Bridge over a road. Show a simple neutral horizontal span crossing above one road line, with a clear gap for movement underneath. Do not draw a building, enclosed volume, facade, cars, road markings, or structural engineering detail. Use a few black architectural ink strokes on white, centered with generous empty space; make the over-and-under relationship immediate.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Steep cliffside. Show a strong diagonal cliff edge with a small neutral platform or site marker cantilevering over the drop and a minimal exposed rock contour beneath. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, door, landscape, or realistic geology. Use sparse black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space; make the dramatic drop clear.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Floating on water. Show a small neutral platform visibly separated from a calm horizontal water surface, with one restrained reflection line below. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, boats, waves, scenery, or realistic reflections; the separation from ground is the concept. Use minimal black hand-drawn architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Cut into a hillside. Show one diagonal land section with a clear retaining edge and a small neutral site void or marker partly embedded in the cut. Do not draw a building, facade, roof, door, or detailed terrain/construction drawing. Use sparse black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space; communicate only the cut-and-embedded relationship.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PLACEMENT constraint Dense city intersection. Show two crossing street edges with three or four tall abstract surrounding corner silhouettes and an empty central site gap. Do not draw a building in the gap, facade detail, cars, signs, repeated windows, or a detailed skyline. Use minimal black architectural ink on white, centered and spacious; show only the compressed intersection context.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Elevation. Draw a generic architectural block as a flat, straight-on front face with a simple ground line and absolutely no receding depth lines. Use sparse, confident black diagrammatic ink on white, centered with generous empty space. The image must communicate a measured facade view, not a finished building.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Plan (top-down). Draw a simple building footprint viewed directly from above, using one outer contour and two or three interior room or circulation lines. Use minimal black architectural diagram ink on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep it schematic and incomplete; do not create a detailed floor plan or add furniture, dimensions, or labels.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint One-point perspective. Draw a generic box-like architectural volume with its receding horizontal edges converging toward one implied vanishing point, while verticals remain vertical. Use only a few black construction lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Do not render a room, street, or finished building; make the single convergence system the concept.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Two-point perspective. Draw a generic architectural corner volume with left and right horizontal edges receding toward two implied vanishing points, while verticals remain straight. Use sparse black hand-drawn diagram lines on white, centered and spacious. Keep the block generic and unfinished; the two-direction convergence must carry the image.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Section (cut-through). Draw a simple building block sliced open vertically, exposing one floor plate and the empty volume above and below it. Use a bold cut edge plus a few light architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Do not add furniture, materials, annotations, or a detailed plan; show the act of cutting through space.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Axonometric. Draw a simple block and footprint lifted upward with parallel receding edges and no vanishing points. Use a few confident black architectural diagram lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep all edges clean but slightly hand-drawn, and do not turn the generic block into a finished building.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Isometric. Draw a compact generic architectural block with three clearly balanced axes and equal-looking diagonal directions. Use sparse black ink lines on a plain white square, centered with generous empty space. Keep it diagrammatic and incomplete, with no textures, materials, labels, or detailed building design.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Three-point perspective. Draw a simple tall block whose horizontal edges recede in two directions and whose vertical edges subtly converge toward a third implied point above or below. Use minimal black architectural construction lines on white, centered with generous empty space. The three convergence directions should be clear without creating a cinematic tower scene.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Worm's-eye view. Draw the underside and rising faces of a generic architectural block as if viewed sharply upward from near the ground. Use a few bold black architectural lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep the view simple and diagrammatic; avoid a dramatic sky, city, facade detail, or finished building.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Bird's-eye / aerial. Draw a generic building block from a steep high viewpoint so the roof and footprint are both visible, with a small ground outline beneath. Use sparse black architectural ink on white, centered with generous empty space. Do not add a city, landscape, map symbols, or realistic aerial atmosphere; show only the elevated view relationship.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Exploded axon. Draw a simple axonometric building separated into two or three vertically aligned layers with clear gaps between them. Use minimal black architectural ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep each layer generic and schematic; do not add labels, arrows, assembly detail, materials, or a fully designed building.

Create a square 1:1 black-and-white visual cue for the PERSPECTIVE constraint Sectional perspective. Draw a generic architectural volume cut open on one side, showing a simple interior floor and spatial depth in perspective. Use a few bold cut edges and sparse black ink lines on white, centered with generous empty space. Keep the interior abstract and incomplete; do not draw furniture, materials, or a finished room.
